title: I Want To Play MC!
description: A modpack that aims to improve the existing game without adding a ton of new content.
body:
I was sick of swimming through kitchen sinks, quest trees, magic and tech, when I was only looking for something a little newer. So this pack is based off the premise that I only wanted to play MC.

All this modpack does is make it prettier, a little bit more immersive, and a little bit easier for people like me who dont need a million new things - a "vanilla plus" that focuses entirely on VANILLA. Hope you enjoy!

THIS MODPACK IS BUILT OFF OF [FABULOUSLY OPTIMIZED](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) - I TAKE NO CREDIT FOR ANY OF THE AMAZING WORK PUT INTO THE MODS I'VE COBBLED TOGETHER.
